summary: B's race condition is the binding defect. The emulator with delay_s=2 (analogous to node-escape's pre-detached-fork window) shows B CAN capture the grandchild when the probe attaches before the fork. With delay_s=0 (analogous to the spawn-then-attach production sequence), the probe loses the race deterministically. 5/5 immediate-fork iterations missed both grandchildren.

race_avoided_test.note: B works correctly when externally sequenced to attach before fork; this is not the production sequence.

kevent_data_observation: kevent.data == 0 in every observed fork event; child PID not delivered by kqueue EVFILT_PROC NOTE_FORK on macOS 14.7.4 arm64.
